messages:
rachel: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's spike. root cause looks like SNI-forwarder lag + probe-orchestrator race causing brief misroutes and retry amplification.
diego: paste tiny timeline? that helped earlier.
rachel: small excerpt below
rachel: ```
2026-03-30T21:33:02Z probe-orch: roll-forward target eu-north v12
2026-03-30T21:33:03Z sni-forwarder queued cert update (delay ~7s)
2026-03-30T21:33:04Z lb routed traffic -> backend-eun (sidecar had old cert)
2026-03-30T21:33:06Z client retries -> 502/504 burst ~50s
```
mina: TL;DR: orchestrator flips routing before sni-forwarder/populate job completes. retries then amplify the short window.
diego: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) make orchestrator wait-for-populate signal 2) add 10s debounce on route flips 3) cap client-edge retries to 3 with randomized backoff
rachel: owners & tentative ETAs recorded in the PM doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2026-03-30-sni-orch-race
- diego: orchestrator wait-for-populate signal + unit tests — ETA 2026-04-01 18:00 UTC
- mina: edge retry-cap feature-flag + canary — ETA 2026-04-01 08:00 UTC
- rachel: add debounce to flip job + rollout plan — ETA 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC
ops-bot: runbook stub created: https://docs.internal/runbooks/sni-orch-race
deploy-bot: scheduling maintenance window 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z
mina: I'll push retry-cap behind a feature flag and canary to eu-north first. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge/pulls/560
diego: adding wait-for-populate to orchestrator in a small PR. will include metrics for populate-duration.
rachel: add a new dashboard tile: populate.duration by region and route-flip latency. alert if populate.duration > 5s and flip occurs.
infra-oncall: prefer apply in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window, will monitor TLS/error rates for 1h post-deploy. will page if >0.4% for 5m.
diego: quick note: found two prior small events with same signature on 2026-02-21 and 2026-01-14. adding 90-day pattern review task.
mina: PR opened -> link above. feature-flag added for quick rollback.
deploy-bot: infra PR 560 merged; deploy dq-2301 started at 2026-04-01T02:05:12Z
deploy-bot: deploy dq-2301 succeeded at 2026-04-01T02:11:39Z
ops-bot: post-deploy health check: no routing flips and TLS errors within baseline for 45m
rachel: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-04-03 09:00 PT to validate and close items. please update the PM doc when you mark tasks done. thanks everyone!
